description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as the invoice issuer name, invoice date, contact number, address, and total (actual payment) amount
description_zh: 支持包括开票方名称、开票日期、联系电话、地址、合计（实际）金额等关键字段结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-shopping-receipt --url http://duguang-database-public.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/multi_receipt_shopping_receipt/shop_receipt_ticket_2020-05-14-11-59-30.540668_01_List.jpg --biz-body '图片二进制' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeShoppingReceipt

parameters.help_en: Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; Base64 is not supported)
parameters.help_zh: 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Binary byte stream of the image, up to 10 MB
parameters.help_zh: 图片二进制字节流，最大10MB
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if recognition succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
